title: The vagus nerve maps the internal milieu

statements.text: The vagus nerve is mostly sensory, about 80 percent afferent, and reaches nearly every internal organ. Converging on the nucleus tractus solitarius, it builds dynamic maps of the internal milieu and supports a continuous representation of the organism as a primary substrate for consciousness.
